automatable_note: A short-circuit bridge must be fitted on the two gold contacts before power-up and removed afterwards. The bench cannot do this.

manual.action: Fit the short-circuit bridge on the two gold contacts, or hold a start button there while powering up.
manual.action_de: Kurzschlussbrücke auf die beiden Goldkontakte stecken, oder dort einen Starttaster beim Einschalten halten.

entry.confirm_signal: One signal (LED flash and beep with motor connected) after about 5 s recognises the brake or motor-off position.
steps: Plug the receiver lead into the motor channel. Transmitter on. Throttle and trim to brake if the short-circuit brake is wanted, else to motor-off.
Power the receiver (opto types need a receiver battery).
Operator: fit the short-circuit bridge on the two gold contacts (between the black and blue battery cables). A pushbutton held down while powering works in place of the bridge.
Apply drive power. After about 5 s the ESC signals that it has detected the brake / motor-off position.
Move the throttle to full and keep it there until the ESC signals the full position, about 5 s after the last signal.
Brake wanted: move the throttle to motor-off. Brake not wanted: leave it at full.
After about 5 more s a double signal confirms storing.
Start button function (optional): press the start button again within about 5 s; another double signal confirms.
Disconnect drive power and remove the bridge. After reconnecting, a double signal after about 1 s shows readiness once the throttle is at motor-off or brake.

announce.description: A single signal ends an intermediate step and asks for the next stick position. A double signal ends a whole operation.

select.description: Move the throttle to full after the first signal and hold until the second signal, about 5 s later.

skip.description: Not applicable: the stick sequence is fixed.

scheme.confirm_signal: Double signal (two LED flashes with beeps) after about 5 s: settings stored.
scheme.exit: Disconnect power and remove the bridge.
scheme.description: Stick-position teach-in with timed waits of about 5 s. The ESC signals each recognised stick position; a double signal confirms storing. The throttle signal alone (motor-off, full, motor-off) can be driven by the bench; only the bridge is manual.

items.name: Throttle positions: brake or motor-off, full

values.name: on: throttle to motor-off after the full-throttle signal
enabled by pressing the start button after the double signal

unknowns: Signal is an LED flash with a beep when the motor is connected; beep duration is not stated.
The ~5 s intervals are approximate; their tolerance is not stated.
A wrong programming attempt shows no double signal; the ESC then stores nothing.
Reset to defaults is not described.
Item numbers are step order chosen here; the ESC does not sound item numbers.
Input voltage and current of the models are not given in these manuals.
notes: The OPTO and BEC manuals describe the same sequence; the BEC manual lists a type table that the text does not contain.
